profile.headline: Software Engineer at Node Reaction
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer, specializing in Javascript, React, Redux, Node, NoSQL & SQL. I'm also the co-founder of Node Reaction, a NodeJS tool, which is a platform agnostic performance monitoring service and installable framework that lives in user code and analyzes route & asynchronous operation performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
NodeReaction was inspired by a group of developers at RetroWave Labs and their curiosity in the Event Loop and Async Hooks. We here at RetroWave Labs share a common love of contributing to the open source community. Our goal was to build a tool where developers could see the granular performance of their asynchronous activity, so they would be able to easily optimize their applications. With this in-depth level of data, it was important to have a user interface that was easy to use, and robust in visualizing the granularity of this data.

NodeReaction is a platform agnostic performance monitoring service, and installable framework that lives in user code and analyzes route and asynchronous operation performance. NodeReaction.com is the service users go to to view a breakdown in the performance of their applications. With a single line of code, users can see the performance and health of their Node server, and understand where bottlenecks exist in their application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TriviaSource |  Crowd-sourced Trivia Question Database Game |  Software Engineer  	
•	Created a full-stack application, utilizing NoSql Mongo database for speed, Node, and jQuery for single page application.
•	Utilized Node with Express middleware and cookies to create sessions so existing users are redirected to their user page

BudgetBook |  Quick and easy lifestyle budgeting application |  Software Engineer  	
•	Developed React based Datamatic budget and spending graphs with transactional data bound to React elements for real-time visualizations.
•	Applied React Router for route transitions to optimize state propagation and re-rendering across nested components.
•	Integrated Redux, improving scalability and promoting data immutability to ease debugging by centralizing state, dividing application concerns into specific modules, and eliminating complex prop chains.
•	Implemented Material UI on the client side to foster user trust and interest by appealing to visual aesthetics.

Web Pouch |  Javascript performance tool utilizing Web Assembly and C++ |  Software Engineer      
•	Created a Javascript library utilizing and creating C++ data structure methods, and compiling them into a WASM file to make Javascript data structures perform faster.

positions.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst, Marketing Division
positions.description:
•	Developed a scalable VBA dashboard providing tools to automate analytics and budget detection to reconcile all fixed assets. 
•	Created a diffing algorithm powered by Pivot Tables, filters, and Lawson Enterprise Resource Planning to compare and correct state changes in financial records by combining historical records and transactions to forecast daily profits.
•	Mandated software updates on the client end by taking advantage of VBA’s ability to write to its own modules.

positions.title: Healthcare Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed API using DLL hooks in legacy mainframe emulator to get, set and release data on the mainframe, as well as release pending loss-run and plan renewal reports. 
•	Developed Visual Basic scripts to automatically query IBM AS400 databases to extract production and healthcare data for analysis.

positions.title: Cost Control Manager
positions.description:
•	Prepared and analyzed monthly financial statements, P&L statements, and management reports.
•	Increased total sales from previous quarter by 10 percent to a total of $ 47,000. 
•	Developed excel model to analyze and track sales, losses, revenue, operating expenses, and cost of goods sold.
•	Provided primary leadership in overhead and administrative budgets.
